kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أُمّ غِيلَان or أُمّ غَيْلَان • (ʔumm ḡīlān or ʔumm ḡaylān) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally mother of ghouls, that is the abode of ghouls.
g: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see أُمّ (ʔumm), غَيْلَان (ḡaylān).
gum arabic tree, Vachellia nilotica; gum-bearing acacia (Vachellia gummifera, which is spread in Morocco, delimiting the distribution of Vachellia nilotica more eastwards)
